peoples_entry.name: Ruin Mutants, Ghouls & Anomaly Cultists
peoples_entry.note: Dungeon aberrations, bio-vat escapees, and forbidden-signal cultists haunting Ancient ruins, karst caves, and dead-zones: ruptured biogel vat-brutes, polypore spore-husk shamblers, Ancient's Valley radiation ghouls, Tethis barnacle-drowned spawn, RC-6 Starlight-Call zealots, entropy-calcified Stilled-Ground husks, rogue Lab-AI wire-cultists, and defaced eclipse sun-heretics.
